newsitem.title: FRANCE: CSC to handle KLM cargo at Paris/CDG.
newsitem.headline: CSC to handle KLM cargo at Paris/CDG.

text.p: The French arm of Cargo Service Centre (CSC), said it had been appointed KLM Royal Dutch Airlines' freight handling agent at Paris-CDG airport, under the terms of a three-year, self-handling agreement, effective May 1 1997.
CSC is a subsidary of KLM specialising in physical cargo handling, document handling and trucking.
KLM's cargo at Paris/CDG is currently handled by French operator, France Handling.

"While current Paris airport authority regulations do not allow us to undertake physical handling on behalf of "third party" airlines, there are no restrictions on us providing warehouse handling services to forwarding agents and we are looking to develop our activities at CDG in this direction," CSC France's general manager, Herve Goffaux, told Reuters.
CSC France will be operating from new premises at CDG from May 1 1997.
"We will be moving into dedicated facilities covering 1,350 sq.m of warehousing and 310 sq.m of offices located in the new extension of the Sogaris freight centre at CDG," Goffaux added.
